hook:
What if the Sun
suddenly disappeared?
final_caption:
The only light left
is the one you made.

stages.label: 8 minutes of light
captions:
Sunlight takes 8 minutes to
reach us. So for now… nothing.

stages.label: Darkness
captions:
Then the sky goes black.
In the middle of the day.

stages.label: The moon is gone too
captions:
The Moon only shines with
reflected sunlight. It vanishes.

stages.label: Freezing
captions:
Without sunlight, temperatures
fall below freezing in days.

stages.label: Ice age
captions:
Plants die. The river
starts to freeze over.

stages.label: Grid failing
captions:
Power plants struggle.
The city lights flicker out.

stages.label: Frozen world
captions:
Earth drifts through space,
frozen solid.

title: What If the Sun Disappeared? ☀️
description: What would happen if the Sun vanished?
